description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface. It manages a LogView component, sets up its layout, appearance, and updates the scroll position when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, used to display log messages and automatically scrolls to the bottom when new logs are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom when log text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
